slides.title: NGN NCLEX-RN Practice Question
text: The nurse is caring for a client in the emergency department (ED) who has burns to both arms following a kitchen grease fire in the home. The nurse notes the client has superficial partial-thickness burns on most of the anterior surfaces of both arms, but the hands are not affected. The client also has a few superficial burns on half of the posterior surfaces of both arms. For each assessment finding, use an “X” to indicate whether the nursing actions below are indicated, contraindicated, or non-essential for the client’s care at this time.
Manage the client’s pain with analgesia
Assist the client with taking a shower
